summary.text: Hollis Lewis is a Democratic member of the West Virginia House of Delegates for District 57, which he has represented since November 2023, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He is an attorney by training and a former Kanawha County magistrate judge.

paragraphs.text: Hollis Lewis was born in Charleston, West Virginia, and graduated from George Washington High School.
He earned a B.S. in criminal justice from West Virginia State University in 2005 and a J.D. from the Southern University Law Center in 2012.
His career experience includes working as a law clerk, Kanawha County magistrate judge, adjunct professor and director.
Lewis assumed office in the House of Delegates on November 3, 2023, succeeding Democrat Douglas Skaff Jr., and advanced from the Democratic primary on May 12, 2026.
